state.description: GTC: Construct approximately 6 miles of 115kV line with minimum 170C 1351 ACSS conductor from Gillsville Tap Junction to Pond Fork, utilizing the existing GTC owned portion of the North Jackson - Lawrence Smith 46kV ROW. At Pond Fork, install a second 230/115kV 400MVA auto transformer and terminate the Pond Fork - Midway 115kV line.

q.instructions: Is this town a fair approximate location for the endpoint?

criteria.true: The endpoint is named after this town (e.g. 'Bluffton' substation near Bluffton, SC).
criteria.false: The name only shares a word with the town or clearly refers to something elsewhere (e.g. 'Union Pier' is not Union, SC).
